evidence.quote: Kelvion continues to lead the way in green technologies with the launch of our latest plate size of GB 790.
The counter air cooler FM-FX32 is now available as Multi-Gas unit for A1, A2L and A3 refrigerants, as well as FM-CX80 for CO2 up to 80 bar.
The KCC/KCB ceiling-mounted air cooler series is adapted for use with A1, A2L and A3 refrigerants. The new FX32 combines HX32 (A1) and FX28 (A2L)
